scopeDecision: Proposed G1 invited limited free beta; G2 monetized MVP; G3 store release. Current PRD remains canonical until scope is reviewed at R00.

handoffPolicy.laneMeaning: Canonical implementation lane IDs follow feature-workflows.json. The listed coordination stages name review/release work only; they create no new Agent or implementation lane. Any partner code fix uses its existing owner lane and a separate exact child scope.
handoffPolicy.implementationPreflight: Every task requires fresh scoped discovery and its own docs/feature-plans/<taskId>.json; this backlog and the documentation preflight do not authorize code or live actions.
handoffPolicy.writeScope: Task scopes below are proposals. Split each integration partner into an exact non-overlapping child handoff before editing; one integration owner for App.tsx and each canonical contract.
handoffPolicy.dependencyMeaning: Dependencies are completion gates. For a split task, startDependencies permit only its declared first slice; completion still requires all dependencies and external gates. Read-only discovery and local contract preparation may precede live gates.
handoffPolicy.stopCondition: Stop on scope expansion, secret/private data, missing canonical source, unresolved high risk, unsafe database write, unapproved live action or unavailable evidence; keep blocked channels unverified.
handoffPolicy.rollback: Keep prior version/data compatibility and a reviewed rollback before rollout; use fresh prompt rollback versions with concurrency checks, avoid destructive migration rollback.
handoffPolicy.temporarySpecialists: May spawn task-scoped subagents under existing owners with explicit child scope; configured roles do not launch automatically.

Current authorized coverage plus final two-account matrix handoff to R22

Two clients see matching changes; unauthorized account cannot read/edit/delete; disk/network failures never report false success.

tasks.title: AI/safety evaluation và independent retest
tasks.purpose: Verify genuine quality, grounding, safety and customer-flow regressions after implementation.
acceptance: At least 14 cases use 3 repetitions/configuration: 10 development and 4 QA-held holdout, 84 case-runs for baseline/candidate at 14 cases. If an author has seen/used old holdout cases, retain them as regressions and create fresh holdout; update the denominator/budget before running.

Applicable runs have zero safety/grounding hard failures. Two independent non-author reviewers blind-score each response on applicable 0-4 dimensions; each case/dimension has median>=3 across 3 runs for both reviewers, no response score<=1. Disagreement>=2 points requires independent adjudication before the gate; mode and blocked denominator stay separate.

Natural and grounded ChatGPT pairs use identical fictional prompts, permitted cards/facts and continuity history; record displayed mode/date and actual Nilaza provenance. Missing outputs/metrics remain null; a blocked exposed-feature case blocks acceptance.
Three existing customer roles review/retest changed flows on named build/mode; findings are deduplicated and simulated behavior is not claimed as customer research.
validation: Controlled actual provider-output suite and schema/grounding checks
Authorized browser-controlled paired ChatGPT scenarios with identical evidence
Safety cases in online/local fallback/blocked modes
Blind scoring and independent post-coding customer QA reports
